name: 36067 · Prattville, AL
findings: ZIP 36067 (Prattville) has 66 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 18 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 36067 (Prattville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 36067 (Prattville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).
